title: Eval candidate template identity
description: Run from the checkout. Uses an authenticated loopback gateway and disposable synthetic project, experiment and run stores. Also admits an experiment-local snapshot and reads back its result without changing the live default. Starts no runner or tmux session.

default-and-repeat.intent: The default UI request freezes the configured template bytes; matching repeats retain the digest and stale repeats fail without changing the experiment. A local-file trial keeps its frozen bytes after the source disappears, records its hash in candidate/result and leaves the live default unchanged. Filename-only platform restrictions survive snapshot storage and reject an incompatible slot.
